headline: Every carton of eggs checked, not a sample.
label: #FFFFFF
heroLede: Josh's Rainbow Eggs collects free-range eggs at Monegeetta and packs them in 18-egg cartons, sold in select Coles, Woolworths, IGA, Foodworks and LaManna stores. Your grading room already uses a light under the eggs to take out cracked ones. A camera after the grader can then check every finished carton. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every carton is closed and latched, with no egg holding the lid up. An open carton on a shelf usually means broken eggs and a complaint.
labelLede: Cartons look much the same from a distance. The camera checks every carton carries the right label for the pack being run that day, straight and intact.
codeLede: Eggs carry a best-before date that has to be right on every carton. The system reads the printed date and compares it with the date set for the day.
objectLede: Feathers, straw and bits of packaging find their way into any grading room. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before cartons are boxed.

vocab.alert: Four lids not latched in fifteen minutes. Check the carton closer.
